exclusion_criteria: Papers that use a single canonical recipe without discussing alternatives
Papers that treat recipe choice as arbitrary without principled justification
Non-peer-reviewed papers (except working papers from established research groups)
Papers not addressing aggregation of multiple definitions/dimensions/indicators
